query: SELECT toUnixTimestamp(time) AS sample_unix,virtual_table_name,tag_names,tag_values,metrics_float_names,metrics_float_values FROM deepflow_admin.deepflow_server_local WHERE virtual_table_name='deepflow_server_ingester_ckwriter' AND tag_values[indexOf(tag_names,'host')]='f2e9872ccdfd' AND position(tag_values[indexOf(tag_names,'table')],'l7_flow_log')>0 AND time>=toDateTime(1793021362) AND time<=toDateTime(1793021863) ORDER BY time,tag_values FORMAT JSONEachRow
command: SELECT toUnixTimestamp(time) AS sample_unix,virtual_table_name,tag_names,tag_values,metrics_float_names,metrics_float_values FROM deepflow_admin.deepflow_server_local WHERE virtual_table_name='deepflow_server_ingester_ckwriter' AND tag_values[indexOf(tag_names,'host')]='f2e9872ccdfd' AND position(tag_values[indexOf(tag_names,'table')],'l7_flow_log')>0 AND time>=toDateTime(1793021362) AND time<=toDateTime(1793021863) ORDER BY time,tag_values FORMAT JSONEachRow

fault_context_from_coordinator.acceptance: before/during/after60/60 each;180unique rows; no missing/duplicate (reported by coordinator)

interpretation: GetCounter clears values on each periodic collection; sum point increments, never last minus first.
retry and retry_failed are additional attempts; write_success/failed/uncertain are rows. Uncertain is a subset of failed.
Only current candidate host and L7 writer queues, from container startup through observation, are included. No debug counter reset was triggered.
Stats delivery shares the failed ClickHouse sink and can arrive late/be missing. Stored zero or no row cannot prove absence of events.
Default sample cycle is10s. Boundary buckets include warmup/after traffic; this is not an exact during-only partition.
Local table avoids Distributed fanout; query readonly2/max_threads1/max_execution_time10 are session-only limits, with no persistent settings or service/table/logging changes.

coverage.note: No internal gaps in these44stored points. Initial61seconds after container startup have no stored L7 counter point; module registration/first flush timing was not independently established. Counts cover all stored startup-window points, including warmup/after, not only c1.
